question: There are six-person Nilima, Priya, Kaushik, Uday, Anand, and Santosh are sitting in a circle not necessarily in the same order. All are facing outside the centre. Nilima and Priya are sitting opposite to each other. No one is sitting between Anand and Kaushik. Uday is sitting immediately right of the person who is opposite to Kaushik. Santosh is not sitting immediate right of Priya. Then find how many person are sitting between Kaushik and Uday (Count from the right side of the Kaushik).
solution:
The logic follows here is:

There are six-person Nilima, Priya, Kaushik, Uday, Anand, and Santosh are sitting in a circle not necessarily in the same order. 

1) Nilima and Priya are sitting opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6e0950e40b99fceaf8fbfda6d25d893514117cec004ef6617c34837d83c3f68.png] 

2) No one is sitting between Anand and Kaushik

So, there is a possibility of four arrangements for these sitting arrangements.

Arrangement 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b1b7386ec403f4160b105be4d66d3019c9d26bafc92c9181486f83d529c7e38.png] 

Arrangement 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4207fbc06cb22040ab3b383ea99687aa9ceaf7fb32b5c0672da78ea8a31d653e.png] 

Arrangement 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc24e1fdae0f6ec5197dc6e234a975222c9b054207c97fd4142b690d50ef1d99.png]

3) Uday is sitting immediate right of the person who is opposite to Kaushik.

Only arrangement 1 and arrangement 2 follow the given condition.

Therefore,

Arrangement 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d5dcc0d8b361f61a5d6d138068bcb0d078e9d657babc86f1a6002c896f62da6.png] 

Arrangement 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/687185cf415cc46efdf67710efbc4cd322ee2a409fba54c2d8d99ddf85dfbaad.png] 

4) Santosh is not sitting immediate right of Priya

Arrangement 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdbf2198ceab7e4eba4fd62a71737a1263913b354beaa05b3b1e6eb7fba3c7f9.png] 

Arrangement 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cfa9b94533f64a0a4c3d397422773c8102be733f0efabb72e7235550cc3600c.png] 

Here, in arrangement 2 Santosh is sitting immediate right of Priya.

Therefore, the only arrangement that follows the given condition is arrangement 1.

Therefore, the final sitting arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/572cdf5eaf546d1d8ca35bf5a8989d5c155231d3cc7526b36611b112c4c9db37.png] 

From the above arrangement, it is clear that there are 3 person sitting between Kaushik and Uday when counted from the right side of the Kaushik.

Hence, the correct answer is **3.**
